name: Open outside prior range, rejected back inside
hypothesis: An open above yesterday's high that falls back below it within the first hour is a rejected auction; short toward yesterday's close.

definition.name: Open outside prior range, rejected back inside

entry.short: session().open > session().prev_high and cross_below(close, session().prev_high) and minutes_since_open() <= 60
entry.long: session().open < session().prev_low and cross_above(close, session().prev_low) and minutes_since_open() <= 60
